name: bdd-ai-toolkit
description: AI-powered toolkit for debugging and managing BDD test cases in Cucumber/Gherkin format with intelligent code analysis

bddAiToolkit.cucumber.copilotPrompt.default:
Apply the authenticated canonical autogenesis Skill exactly.

# Explicit recording request for this exact BDD test case
${scenario_text}

Feature context: '${feature_file_path}'

Requirements:
1. Route this explicit recording request only through generate_scenario_test.
2. Before the first supplied step, call before_gen_code.
3. Execute and verify every supplied step exactly in order, then call preview_code_changes.
4. Stop after the read-only preview and report that generated-file writes are unavailable.
5. Never request write approval or copy, save, shell-write, or otherwise persist the proposed bytes.
bddAiToolkit.cucumber.copilotPrompt.description: Preview-only recording request template used after authenticating the canonical autogenesis Skill. Use ${scenario_text} for scenario content and ${feature_file_path} for Feature context.

languageModelTools.name: sendNaturalLanguageTask
languageModelTools.modelDescription: 🤖 GENERATES FORMATTED MCP EXECUTION PROMPT: Creates a structured prompt that instructs Copilot to immediately execute automation tasks using native-mcp-server MCP tools. The response contains explicit instructions for Copilot to use MCP tools for every action, not just descriptions. After calling this tool, Copilot should immediately begin executing the formatted prompt using native-mcp-server tools.

taskDescription.description: Natural language description of the testing task that will be converted into MCP execution instructions
